title: Correlated pair distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with at least two elements, and let $\rho$ satisfy $-1/(|\Omega|-1)\le\rho\le1$. Define a probability distribution on $\Omega\times\Omega$ by choosing the first coordinate uniformly from $\Omega$, then choosing the second according to the coordinate noise distribution with parameter $\rho$ centered at the first coordinate.
